exposure: women with scar dehiscence vs women without scar dehiscence
cohort: 300 parturient undergoing cesarean section at the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics and Department of Anesthesiology, Combined Military Hospital, Okara, from July to December 2018.
finding: No use of antepartum nutritional supplements, early term pregnancy, emergency LSCS, laboring for more than 24 hours and shorter inter-delivery gap were independent risk factors for scar dehiscence in patients with a history of previous cesarean sections.
